s1.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of immobility, mutism, and systemic stiffness with abdominal distension and altered mental status
salient_findings: Mute with vacant stare and no eye contact
key_facts: 56-year-old female
History of diabetes mellitus
History of mental illness diagnosed in 1998
Stable on quetiapine for many years
Developed new symptoms including stupor in 2016
Condition deteriorated in November 2017
Abdominal distension and tympany on physical exam
Absent bowel sounds on physical exam
No guarding or rigidity of abdomen on physical exam
Bilateral rigidity on neurological exam
Mental status: mute with vacant stare and no eye contact
Hypomagnesemia and hypokalemia on laboratory tests
Abdominal CT showed accumulated air and fecal matter, dilated intestine with air-fluid levels
Brain CT and MRI showed no remarkable findings

shortlist.why_kept: Patient's symptoms of immobility, mutism, and systemic stiffness with altered mental status are consistent with malignant catatonia

shortlist.label: Catatonic schizophrenia
shortlist.why_kept: Patient's history of mental illness and current symptoms of catatonia are consistent with catatonic schizophrenia

shortlist.label: Lethal catatonia

shortlist.why_kept: Abdominal distension, tympany, and absent bowel sounds on physical exam are consistent with paralytic ileus
